diff.content:
diff --git a/metrics/exporters.py b/metrics/exporters.py
--- a/metrics/exporters.py
+++ b/metrics/exporters.py
@@ -40,6 +40,16 @@ def format_sample_point(timestamp, tags):
     return f"{timestamp.isoformat()}Z|{','.join(f'{k}={v}' for k, v in sorted(tags.items()))}"
 
 
+def export_latency(sample, timestamp, tags):
+    label = f"{timestamp.isoformat()}Z|{','.join(f'{k}={v}' for k, v in sorted(tags.items()))}"
+    return f"latency {sample} {label}"
+
+
+def export_throughput(sample, timestamp, tags):
+    label = f"{timestamp.isoformat()}Z|{','.join(f'{k}={v}' for k, v in sorted(tags.items()))}"
+    return f"throughput {sample} {label}"
+
+
 def export_error_rate(sample, timestamp, tags):
     label = f"{timestamp.isoformat()}Z|{','.join(f'{k}={v}' for k, v in sorted(tags.items()))}"
     return f"error_rate {sample} {label}"
diff --git a/tests/test_exporters.py b/tests/test_exporters.py
--- a/tests/test_exporters.py
+++ b/tests/test_exporters.py
@@ -12,1 +12,9 @@ def test_export_error_rate_includes_the_label():
     assert "error_rate" in export_error_rate(0.01, NOW, {"region": "east"})
+
+
+def test_export_latency_includes_the_label():
+    assert "latency" in export_latency(120, NOW, {"region": "east"})
+
+
+def test_export_throughput_includes_the_label():
+    assert "throughput" in export_throughput(1000, NOW, {"region": "east"})

change_contract.goal: Add latency and throughput exporters alongside the existing error-rate exporter.
acceptance_criteria: Latency samples can be exported with the same label format as error-rate samples.
Throughput samples can be exported with the same label format.

repository_instructions.label: Reuse rules
repository_instructions.summary: When a new function needs formatting behaviour a shared helper already implements, call the helper rather than re-deriving the same expression inline.

nearby_patterns.label: Existing error-rate exporter this change sits beside

data: `format_sample_point(timestamp, tags)` already exists in this module and returns exactly the label string this diff's two new functions each re-derive inline.
`export_error_rate`, already in this module, calls the same inline expression rather than `format_sample_point` - this diff adds two more copies of it rather than fixing the existing one.
operational: A fourth exporter is planned for the next release.
